3. Appellant's case as its appear from the record and submission of the learned advocate in brief is that 29 decimals of land appertaining to Khatian No. 484 in Plot No. 2165/63684 belonged to Niamot Ali, Sherjan Ali and Golam Ali. After their death 12 decimals in plot No. 12163 and 7 decimals in plot No. 12164 appertaining to khatian No. 209 were prepared in the name of their successors. One Ashraf Ali Sharong established a mosque and thereafter, he and others jointly transferred 19 decimals land in favour of Kagadia Eshatul Ulum Madrasha through deed No. 1671 dated 16-5-1940. PS Khatian No. 288/209 was prepared in the name of Kagadia Eshatul Ulum Madrasha. BS Khatian No. 2559 was also prepared in the name of the said Madrasha. 

 4. On the other hand respondent's case, in brief, is that Hazrat Rupchan Shah (R) established the mosque in the year 1885 on a land measuring 12 decimals. After the death of Hazrat Rupchan Shah (R), his heirs Bakor Ali, Kosom Ali maintained the property. After the death of Bakor Ali, Kosom Ali, Niamath Ali, Serjart Ali maintained the property and CS Khatian No. 39 was prepared in their names. When Kosom Ali died, Gulam Ali, Basarath Ali, Abdul Hakim, Mowlana Rahmath All and others took the charge of maintenance of the property and RS Khatian No. 209 was prepared in their names. Mow lava Abu Baker Siddique Faraqui being heirs of Mowlana Rahrnath Ali enrolled the waqf property with Waqf Administrator vide EC No. 16832 on 25-11-1991. The waqf property was enrolled in the name of Hazrat Rupchan Saha (R) mosque waqf estate. 

 5. at the time of enrollment 24 decimals was shown to have been taken on lease from the Government vide lease deed No. 1692 dated 15-3-1990. Akkona Begum and Joynab Khatun also gifted ½ decimals land in favour of Waqf estate. 12 decimals land in plot No. 12163 appertaining to khatian No. 209 and 24 decimals of land in plot No. 13554 appertaining to khatian No. 149 along with the ½ decimals land gifted in favour of the waqf estate (total (12 + 24 + ½ ) = 36½ decimals land) was enlisted in the name of the waqf estate. 

 6. After the enrollment of the waqf estate in the name of Hazrat Rupchand Shah (R) Fakir Mosque Waqf Estate, Md Tofazel Hossain predecessor of the appellant filed an application on 12-12-1999 for enrollment of waqf estate in respect of 19 decimals of land in plot No.12163 and 12166 appertaining to khatian No. 209 in the name of Kagatia Eshatul Madrassa Waqf Estate. Md Tofazel Hossain also filed another application on 14-5-2000. On receipt of the application the waqf Administrator initiated EC Case No. 1 of 2000 and asked the Waqf Inspector to hold an inquiry. Waqf Inspector after inquiry submitted a report on 12-1-2000. In the report dated 12-1-2000 the Waqf Inspector made a recommendation for enrollment of 19 decimals of land in the name of Kagatia Eshatul Ulum Madrassa Waqf Estate and also recommended for appointment of Mr Md Tafazzal Hossain as Mutuwalli of the waqf estate. 

 13. He then submits that BS Khatian was published in the name of Kagadia Eshatul Ulum Madrassa and the very publication established that the deed dated 16-5-1940 was acted upon. But the learned Additional District Judge having failed to take notice of such publication and erroneously passed the judgment and order. 

 22. The respondent's case is that the mosque was established in the year 1895 by one Hazrat Rupchand Shah (R) Fakir and after his death his successors managed the property. The land on which the Mosque was established recorded in the name of Hazrat Rupchand Shah (R) Fakir Mosque. Whereas the appellant case is that Ashraf Ali Sharong established the mosque and subsequently he and others gifted 19 decimals land in the name of the mosque and the property was the waqf property of Kagadia Eshraful Ulum Madras Wafq Estate. Their further case is that the land was recorded in the name of Kagadia Eshraful Ulum Madrasha in RS khatian No. 209 and BS Khatian No. 2259. Whereas the respondent claims that the land was recorded in the name of successors of Hazrat Rupchand Shah (R) Fakir in BS Khatian No. 1199.
